Name: Farm Time Scaler
Author: Mogeekan
Description:
[list]
[b][/b][/list][b]Farm Time Scaler[/b] lets you change how fast time passes on your farm—and optionally in other places. Perfect for big farms where running across fields eats the whole morning.

What it does

[list]
[*]Set a [b]Time multiplier[/b] (e.g. 0.5× = half speed, 2× = double speed) for locations you choose.
[*]Toggle whether it also applies [b]inside the Farmhouse & Cellar[/b], [b]farm building interiors[/b] (barns, coops, sheds, greenhouse, slime hutch, mill, etc.), and the [b]Farm Cave[/b].
[*][b]Custom Locations (per-save):[/b] add/remove your current location to a list that is affected by the time scaler.
[list]
[*]Hotkeys to add/remove; GMCM toggles to log/clear the list.
[/list][*]Subtle [b]HUD tag[/b] under the clock shows when the effect is active (e.g., Star Light Farm x0.5).
[list]
[*]Option to [b]hide the farm name[/b] and show a generic “Farm/Farmhouse” label for smaller screens.
[/list][*]Full in-game configuration via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b], or edit config.json.
[/list]Settings (GMCM)(in the order shown in the menu)
[list]
[*][b]Enable[/b] — master on/off.
[*][b]Affect Farmhouse & Cellar[/b] — scale time at home.
[*][b]Affect farm building interiors[/b] — barns/coops/sheds/greenhouse/slime hutch/mill.
[*][b]Enable Farm Cave[/b] — scale time in the farm cave.
[*][b]Show HUD indicator[/b] — displays x
under the clock.[*][b]HUD: hide farm name[/b] — show generic “Farm/Farmhouse” instead of your farm’s name.
[*][b]Enable Custom Locations[/b] — allow a per-save list of extra locations to be affected.
[*][b]Log Custom Locations (now)[/b] — prints the current per-save list to the SMAPI console.
[*][b]Clear custom locations (now)[/b] — removes all per-save custom locations.
[*][b]Add current location[/b] — keybind (default: LeftShift + L).
[*][b]Remove current location[/b] — keybind (default: LeftShift + K).
[*][b]Time multiplier[/b] — 0.10–3.00 (step 0.05).
[*][b]Toggle hotkey[/b] — enable/disable the effect on the fly (default: LeftShift + OemTilde).
[/list]
[b][size=4]Copying locations settings 1.6+:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Allows the option to copy all custom locations to other saves (If the location exists) OR add/remove locations directly in the files.
[*]Adding locations directly in the file needs to have exactly the same names for them to work.
[*]The Custom Locations file is found in "..\StardewValley\Saves\<YOUR FARM NAME>\data\Mogeekan.FarmTimeScaler\".
[*]This file/folders are only created when the mod is Enabled before creation of a new game, or Enabling the mod on an existing farm and saving the game (Whether locations were added or not).
[*]Copying the Custom Locations file does not require the game to be closed but does require you to be in the main menu and for the farm you are importing to have at least the mod enabled for the file/folders to have generated.
[*]The Custom Locations file does need the Import setting changed to True before loading the save. FROM: [i][b]"[/b][/i][i][b]Import": false[/b][/i] TO: [i][b]"Import": true[/b][/i]
[*][b][size=3]PLEASE NOTE:[/size][/b] If you deleted or moved the custom locations file to another folder, it will be re-created the next time the game launches or when loading a save game (that previously had the mod enabled) whether the mod is installed or not (It pulls the location data from the save game itself if the mod was enabled for that save at any point. This is permanent unless you delete the save).
[/list]
[size=3]Copying Locations Between Saves Quick Steps Guide:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿[b]1:[/b] [/size][size=2]Create a new game with mod enabled or in current game enable the mod and save game at least once.[/size]
[b][size=3]2:[/size][/b][size=2] Ensure you are at the main menu or the game is closed.[/size]
[b][size=3]3:[/size] [/b][size=2]Ensure custom-locations file is created in "..\StardewValley\Saves\<YOUR NEW FARM NAME>\data\Mogeekan.FarmTimeScaler\" and [b]delete-it[/b].[/size]
[size=3][b]4:[/b] [/size][size=2]Navigate to the same folder path but for the save game you are copying the file/locations from.[/size]
[b][size=3]5:[/size] [/b][size=2]Copy the custom-locations file and paste it into your new save folder (The same folder you just deleted the other file in).[/size]
[b][size=3]6:[/size] [/b][size=2]Open the file and change: [/size][i]"[/i][i]Import": false[/i][size=2] [/size][b]TO:[/b][size=2] [/size][i]"Import": true[/i]
[b][size=3]7:[/size] [/b][size=2]Save the file.[/size]
[b][size=3]8:[/size] [/b][size=2]Load the new game/current game, settings should now be listed and apply to your save.
[/size][b][size=3] ﻿Tutorial video-(Not Available yet)[/size][/b]
[size=3]Adding and Removing locations directly in the file Guide:[/size]
[b]﻿1: [/b][size=2]Save the game and exit to main menu or desktop.[/size]
[size=3]﻿[b]2[/b][/size][b]: [/b][size=2]Open the custom-locations file in your save folder "..\StardewValley\Saves\<YOUR NEW FARM NAME>\data\Mogeekan.FarmTimeScaler\".[/size]
[b][size=3]﻿3[/size][/b][size=3][b]:[/b] [/size][size=2]Under CustomLocations inside the brackets add or remove locations, insuring that ever entry has a comma in between and is on a new line. (Note: the last entry should not have a comma)[/size]
[b]5: [/b][size=2]Change [i]"[/i][i]Import": false[/i][size=2] [/size]TO:[size=2] [/size][i]"Import": true[/i][/size]
[b][size=3]4[/size][/b][b]: [/b][size=2]Save the file and load player save.[/size]
[size=3][b]Example:

[/b][/size] ﻿

Tips
[list]
[*] Use the mod’s "Log Custom Locations" or hotkeys to print the exact internal ID for your current spot in SMAPI.
[*] Some buildings have multiple names in different contexts/versions; the ones above are the most common vanilla IDs.
[*] Locations with the same names can cause issues.
[/list]
Requirements

[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.3+[/url]﻿[/b] ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url]﻿)
[*][b](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/b] ([url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/spacechase0?gameId=1303]spacechase0[/url]﻿) for in-game settings
[i](Without GMCM you can still edit Mods/Farm Time Scaler/config.json.)[/i][/list][b]Tested:[/b] Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b], SMAPI [b]4.3.2[/b], GMCM [b]1.15.0[/b]
[b]Multiplayer:[/b] Works in SP & MP. [b]Host controls time[/b]; clients may install for UI, but host settings determine time.
Compatibility

[list]
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and custom farm maps.
[*]Designed to avoid conflicts, but other [b]time-changing mods[/b] (that alter Game1.gameTimeInterval
or time speed) may conflict. Use only one time mod at a time.[/list]Troubleshooting

[list]
[*][b]No GMCM menu?[/b] Ensure GMCM is installed and enabled; check SMAPI console.
[*][b]Time doesn’t change?[/b] Make sure [b]Enable[/b] is on, multiplier ≠ 1.0, you’re in a covered location, and no other time mod is active.
[*][b]HUD overlaps your UI?[/b] Toggle the indicator off or adjust UI scale; this mod’s HUD is anchored under the vanilla clock and auto-sizes.
[/list][b]Uninstall
[/b]
Safe to remove any time; time reverts to vanilla upon next launch.
